review.main: Sky remains smooth. Coarse links are connected. Fine lines and foliage stay soft.
review.mesh: Both cab profiles and exposures viewed with both camera JPEGs and ISO100 AHD. The right remains clearest with incomplete fine crossings.
review.exact: Higher contrast and weaker axes stay separated. Visible gains over the prior Fourier filter are small, and the exact flat controls stay smooth.
